name: Dice Game
description: A polished local dice practice table with animated rolls and no wallet or GAS at risk. Wallet-backed GameFi is temporarily unavailable while the configured Neo N3 settlement deployment is replaced and verified against the audited contract artifact.
description_zh: 精心设计的本地骰子练习桌，包含完整掷骰动画，无需钱包，也不会使用 GAS。当前配置的 Neo N3 结算合约需要替换并按审计产物重新验证，因此钱包 GameFi 模式暂时关闭。

operation_panel.title: Free Dice Practice
operation_panel.subtitle: Choose a face and throw locally. GameFi deposits and paid rolls remain disabled until the Neo N3 settlement deployment passes the compatibility gate.

oracle.description: GameFi is disabled. Guest rolls use local secure randomness; no wallet-funded randomness or settlement path is advertised until a compatible Neo N3 deployment is verified.

aa.description: Direct OneGate and NeoLine signing flow is used for the initial release.
